entities.name: Sandy León
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sandy David León López is a Venezuelan professional baseball catcher in the Atlanta Braves organization. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Washington Nationals, Boston Red Sox, Cleveland Indians/Guardians, Miami Marlins, Minnesota Twins, Texas Rangers, and Atlanta Braves. He has also played for the Colombia national baseball team.
